page: City page: B2B lead generation Delhi (/b2b-lead-generation-delhi)

items.question: Do we need to be based in Delhi to work with you?
items.answer: No. The entire engagement runs remotely from our office in BKC, Mumbai, so it doesn't matter where in NCR, or beyond, your team is based. Strategy calls, sequence approvals and weekly reporting all happen over video calls and a shared dashboard, the same way they do for every client.

items.question: Do you only work with Delhi companies?
items.answer: No. We have clients in Delhi NCR, but we run outbound systems for B2B companies across India and internationally, 130+ B2B companies so far. Campaigns for your buyers use the same process everywhere, with the lists, copy and send timing adapted to the industries and markets you sell to.

items.question: How quickly can we expect meetings to start?
items.answer: Campaigns go live within 18 days of kickoff, and most clients see their first qualified conversations in weeks 3 to 4. The first two weeks go into ICP mapping, list building, sending domains with warm-up, and copy. Meeting volume usually becomes consistent by weeks 6 to 8, once messaging is tuned on real replies.

items.question: What does pricing look like?
items.answer: We work on a monthly retainer with a 3-month minimum, which covers setup and enough sending to judge results. After that it runs month to month with 30 days' notice, with no annual contract. We don't publish a price list; we share a quote after a free GTM audit call, once we know which channels you need.

items.question: Which Delhi NCR industries do you have the most experience with?
items.answer: IT services and SaaS firms in Gurugram and Noida, exporters and manufacturers across NCR, and recruitment, staffing and professional services firms. Examples include 24 meetings for a software development firm winning US clients and 26 meetings for an IT staffing agency. The system adapts to any B2B ICP.

items.question: What channels do you actually use to generate leads?
items.answer: Primarily cold email and LinkedIn outreach aimed at enterprise and trading-sector buyers, layered with account-based marketing to get past procurement gatekeepers on named target accounts, and AI-assisted list building and personalisation underneath all three. We pick the mix based on where your buyers actually spend their attention.

items.question: How is this different from hiring an in-house SDR?
items.answer: Hiring an in-house SDR in Delhi NCR means months of recruiting and ramp-up before they're fully productive, and even then, one person can only run so many sequences at once. A managed outbound system has multiple channels live within about three weeks, at a fraction of the fully loaded cost of a hire, and scales without you managing headcount.

items.question: What do you need from us to get started?
items.answer: A clear picture of your ICP (even a rough one works), access to a domain we can set up for outbound sending, and about an hour of your time for an onboarding call. We handle ICP refinement, list building, sequence writing, and day-to-day campaign management from there.

items.question: Do you cover Gurugram and Noida as well as Delhi?
items.answer: Yes. We run outbound for companies across Delhi NCR, including Gurugram, Noida and Faridabad. Gurugram and Noida have their own pages on our site because their industries differ, with more SaaS and fintech in Gurugram and more IT services and electronics in Noida. The team, process and pricing are the same everywhere.

items.question: How do I choose a lead generation agency in Delhi NCR?
items.answer: Ask four things: whether they have run campaigns in your industry, how they build and verify their lists, what they report each week (meetings and conversations, not just emails sent), and whether you can leave without a long contract. Be wary of an agency that promises a fixed number of leads before seeing your ICP.

items.question: Do you offer appointment setting for Delhi companies?
items.answer: Yes. Appointment setting is part of every engagement: we handle the replies and book qualified meetings straight into your calendar, so your sales team only joins calls with buyers who have agreed to talk. Each meeting comes with notes on the prospect and what they asked about.
